provenance_note: This public summary was abridged after the analyses. It is not the original frozen protocol and does not match the protocol_sha256 in ROBUSTNESS_AUDIT_RESULT.json. Original Moller results and Walsh complete-CC results were already known before the original protocol; the genome-pair distribution and matched Walsh split contrast were not inspected before its freeze. The original artifact is preserved in the source project.
objective: Test whether reported clonal-complex grouping is supported by phenotype-blind whole-genome similarity and whether random splitting is optimistic in an independent Staphylococcus aureus phage-susceptibility cohort.
prohibitions: No feature, model, metric, split, clustering, or threshold selection using new outcomes.
No alteration of previously frozen result artifacts.
The independent Walsh cohort is not pooled with the Moller cohort because assays and phages differ.

genome_similarity_audit.representation: Sourmash DNA MinHash, k=31, scaled=1000, canonical hashing.
genome_similarity_audit.uncertainty: Originally 2,000 pair-bootstrap replicates for similarity/AUC and host-bootstrap replicates for nearest-neighbor agreement. Those intervals do not account adequately for shared-host/lineage dependence and should not be treated as independent-sample evidence. Retained for provenance, not recommended for inference.

independent_cohort_split_comparison.cohort: 45 exact-assembly-QC Walsh hosts with binary ISP spot-test susceptibility.
